QUESTIONS & ANSWERS

Partnership FAQs.

Costs, staffing, payments, and what guests can expect.

What does our venue pay?+

There’s no upfront cost or contract commitment. We supply the photographers and equipment. Your venue receives 20% of photo sales.

Do guests have to buy a photo?+

No. Guests can decline the photo or take one without buying a print. Every photographed guest gets a complimentary personalized postcard.

What do the photos cost?+

A standard 4×6 print in a venue-branded frame is $20, or $15 each for two or more. A digital copy is included by email. Ask about glass frame upgrades and pricing.

What space and staffing do we need?+

Plan for around 3 ft (1 m) of space for the printing station. We’ll confirm the full footprint and placement with you. Our team brings the equipment and runs the station without needing help from your staff.

How do reporting and payments work?+

You receive daily sales reports and a Google Drive link to your photos. We pay your venue’s share every two weeks and confirm payout details during setup.

Where do you operate?+

We serve Miami restaurants and bars. Tell us your location and preferred service days so we can discuss availability.

YOUR PRIVACY

Your visit. Your choice.

Optional website analytics

If you allow it, Google Analytics measures visits, selected campaign links, and partnership inquiry actions: opening the form, starting it, attempting to send, and success or error outcomes. Photo help requests aren’t counted as partnership leads. We don’t send your name, email address, venue name, visit date, or message text to analytics. Advertising features are disabled.

Analytics loads only after you allow it. You can turn it off here at any time. We save your choice in this browser for up to six months and respect browser Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control signals.

How Google uses information from partner sites

Partnership inquiries

We use the contact and venue details you submit to respond to your inquiry. Resend delivers the message to our business inbox. Our website is hosted by Vercel.

Photo help requests

We use your email address, venue name, visit date, and message to look into your photo request and reply to you. Resend delivers these details to our business inbox. Photo help submissions aren’t sent to Google Analytics.
